title: Allard–Schauder regularity: a stationary embedded C¹ submanifold is C^r for every r (Simon Ch. 5, Theorem 7.1, last part; parent step 2)
statement: Higher regularity of stationary C¹ submanifolds. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: m ≥ 1; U is open; M ⊆ U; M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; and M is stationary in U: ∫_M div_M X dH^m = 0 for every C¹ map X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport X ⊆ U, where div_M X(x) := trace(P_x∘DX(x)), P_x is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x), and H^m = μHE[m]. Conclusion: for every r ∈ ℕ, M is an embedded C^r m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → ∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M
